Technical

Stats

Githyanki_Raider_Strong
Githyanki veteran raiders are a stronger version of the Githyanki Raider archetype encountered throughout Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Veteran Raiders are Dexterity-based Battle Master Fighters. They are foot soldiers who specialise in wielding crossbows. The raiders are equally effective at close quarters and long distances.
